req.title: Location header on create
req.statement: The system shall set Location: /players/{new_id} on the 201 Created response.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-027 requires that POST /players/ returns HTTP 201 and sets a Location header. Reading the source, the route sets response.headers['Location'] = f'/players/squadnumber/{player.squad_number}' (NOT /players/{new_id}). Tests must assert the exact header value that the implementation actually produces. Three test cases cover: (1) positive/EP – valid new player yields 201 + correct Location header with squad_number path; (2) negative/NEG – duplicate squad_number yields 409 and no Location header; (3) boundary/BVA – squad_number at the minimum positive integer boundary (1 is taken, so we use a squad_number just above the seeded range, 27, and also verify the header path segment matches exactly). Additional tests cover the exact header key name and value format to kill constant/string mutations.

preconditions: Database is loaded with 26 pre-seeded players (squad numbers 1-26)
Squad number 99 does not exist in the database
actions: POST /players/ with a valid payload using squad_number=99
trace: R-PLAYER-027: Location header set on 201 Created response
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=False)

def test_post_player_returns_201_with_location_header():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Test",
        "lastName": "Player",
        "squadNumber": 99,
        "position": "Centre-Back"
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    assert "location" in r.headers or "Location" in r.headers
    loc = r.headers.get("location") or r.headers.get("Location")
    assert loc == "/players/squadnumber/99"

test_post_player_returns_201_with_location_header()

tests.name: test_post_player_location_header_contains_squad_number_not_uuid
preconditions: Database is loaded with 26 pre-seeded players
actions: Assert Location header path segment is squad_number (not UUID)
expected: Location header does NOT contain a UUID pattern
trace: R-PLAYER-027: verifies the Location path uses squad_number natural key, not UUID surrogate key; kills mutations that swap path segments
tests.executable:
import re
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=False)

def test_post_player_location_header_contains_squad_number_not_uuid():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Natural",
        "lastName": "Key",
        "squadNumber": 50,
        "position": "Left-Back"
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    loc = r.headers.get("location") or r.headers.get("Location")
    assert loc == "/players/squadnumber/50"
    uuid_pattern = re.compile(
        r'[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}',
        re.IGNORECASE
    )
    assert uuid_pattern.search(loc) is None

test_post_player_location_header_contains_squad_number_not_uuid()

preconditions: Database is loaded with 26 pre-seeded players
actions: Assert response body contains id and squadNumber fields
Assert Location header key and value are exact
trace: R-PLAYER-027: verifies both response body and Location header; kills mutations on header key name or path template
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=False)

def test_post_player_location_header_key_is_location_exact():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Header",
        "lastName": "Check",
        "squadNumber": 77,
        "position": "Centre-Forward"
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 77
    assert "id" in body
    loc = r.headers.get("location") or r.headers.get("Location")
    assert loc == "/players/squadnumber/77"
    assert "/players/squadnumber/" in loc
    assert loc != "/players/77"

test_post_player_location_header_key_is_location_exact()
